parameters.name: FuzzyName
parameters.description:
The application name.
- The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and parentheses (()).
- The name must start with a Chinese character, letter, or digit.
- The name can be up to 30 characters in length (a Chinese character counts as one character).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: PageNo
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 200.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.15b03118ooIo9y). In the upper-left corner of the page, select the target instance, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the regular project list, find the target project, click the project card, and view the ID in the address bar.
